title: The first letter, ii
logline: Tuesday. The letter, read aloud to the dog, edited. 'Plush.' The chorus at the back of the panel, twelve strong, holding signs that say YES.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD reading a letter aloud. BARNABY listening. At the back: twelve STICK FIGURES with signs.

balloons.text: '…the Barnaby character as a plush, with a rotor —' no. '— with a range of —' no.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man reading a letter aloud to a small dog in a garage studio while twelve crude stick figures at the back hold up signs

panels.composition: The signs: YES. YES. DO IT. YES. PLUSH. One: NO (very small).

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a row of crude stick figures holding hand-lettered signs, most reading YES and one small one reading NO
image.notes: Letter after: YES ×4, DO IT, PLUSH, one tiny NO.

panels.composition: Wood folding the letter. Looking at the dog. The dog looking at the letter.

balloons.text: You want to be a plush?

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man folding a letter and asking a small dog a question, the dog looking at the letter
image.notes: The dog's thought balloon is empty.

panels.composition: The letter under the short leg of the drafting table. The table level. The coffee still. The chorus, signs down.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a folded letter wedged under the short leg of a drafting table so it sits level, a still mug of coffee on it, stick figures at the back with their signs lowered

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: 'You want to be a plush?' The empty thought balloon. The shim.
